name: four-games-hub
description: Five-world game hub with user-configurable minesweeper mine counts

scripts.test: node --test tests/*.test.mjs && npm test --prefix apps/go-online && npm test --prefix apps/gomoku-online && npm test --prefix apps/star-array
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix apps/go-online && npm run build --prefix apps/gomoku-online
scripts.check: node --check hub/server.mjs && node --check hub/public/assets/main.js && node --check hub/learning/assets/gomoku-ai.js && node --check hub/learning/assets/mines-ai.js && node --check hub/learning/assets/mine-config.js
